description: This PHP class 'updateDependencies' is designed to handle dependency updates for project tasks within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment. It updates dependent task dates based on changes to a parent task, managing finish-to-start (FS) and start-to-start (SS) relationships; uses methods like 'update_dependency' and 'count_days'.

classes.name: updateDependencies
classes.description: A class responsible for updating task dependencies and date calculations in a project management module of SuiteCRM.

methods.name: update_dependency
methods.description: Main method that updates dependent tasks' start and finish dates based on changes to a parent task, considering dependency types.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between two dates, returning a string indicating positive or negative days.
